annotations.title: Live CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) active-exploitation

description: [0.004000 USDC via x402] Checks any CVE identifier or vendor/product keyword against the live CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, returning active exploitation status, ransomware usage, due dates, and CWEs.

limit.description: Maximum matching KEV entries to return (1 to 15, default 5).

query.description: Exact CVE ID (e.g., 'CVE-2024-21762') or vendor/product keyword (e.g., 'Fortinet', 'Ivanti').

name: check_cisa_kev_exploits
title: Live CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) active-exploitation
